subject: prd/impl-review
statement: The reviewer and the harvest shall treat an operator-class disposition as valid only when it is attributable to the operator's own identity on the tracker medium (not a bot-writable field); an unattributable operator-class disposition shall be excluded from the calibration corpus.
rationale: the disposition is the adoption ground truth; a forgeable one is worse than none
fit_criterion: a fixture where a worker-authored "operator accepted" disposition is excluded from M2; inspection confirms operator-class dispositions derive from the operator's medium act, never a bot-editable payload field
